examName: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals
note: Domain weights reflect the skills-measured outline published on Microsoft Learn as of 2026-07-28. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam.

domains.name: Describe the concepts of security, compliance, and identity
subtopics: Shared responsibility, defense-in-depth, Zero Trust, encryption and hashing, GRC
Identity as the security perimeter: authentication, authorization, identity providers, directory services, federation

domains.name: Describe the capabilities of Microsoft Entra
subtopics: Microsoft Entra ID, identity types (including agent ID), and hybrid identity
Authentication methods, MFA, and password protection
Conditional Access and Entra roles / RBAC
ID Governance, access reviews, Privileged Identity Management, and ID Protection

domains.name: Describe the capabilities of Microsoft security solutions
subtopics: Azure infrastructure security: DDoS Protection, Firewall, WAF, VNet segmentation, NSGs, Bastion, Key Vault
Microsoft Defender for Cloud and cloud security posture management
Microsoft Defender XDR services and the Defender portal

domains.name: Describe the capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions
subtopics: Service Trust Portal and Microsoft's privacy principles
Microsoft Purview portal, Compliance Manager, and compliance score
Data classification, sensitivity labels, DLP, records management, and retention
Insider risk management, eDiscovery, and audit
